operations.content: Application protocol v1 (not native tools). Reply with exactly one JSON object then EOS, no prose. Tool: {"version":1,"type":"tool","id":"unique_id","name":"calculator","arguments":{"operation":"add","a":19,"b":24}}. Operations: add/subtract/multiply; integer inputs within +/-1000000. Results arrive as user messages labeled APPLICATION_TOOL_RESULT_V1. Final: {"version":1,"type":"final","answer":0}. Use calculator to compute 19 + 24, then give the final integer answer.
